transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because I've been noticing a pattern for months now. Things like... my sister's appointments getting moved without me knowing. Bills showing up wrong. People constantly forgetting to call me back. 

Everyone keeps telling me it's just mistakes, but... I know that's not true. I know they're keeping information from me on purpose. They're trying to push me out of decisions. That's... that's really all it is.
Can you tell me more about how you know people are keeping information from you on purpose? Have you noticed any specific actions or patterns that make you feel this way?

Well... it's just like I was saying. It's the pattern. 

In my line of work, I know how schedules and paperwork are supposed to be handled. You don't just have bills show up wrong month after month by accident. And my sister's appointments... they get moved, and somehow I'm always the only one who isn't informed. People say they just 'forgot' to call me back, but... once or twice is a mistake. This is constant. 

They're keeping things from me so I can't be involved in the decisions. I don't really want to get into all the specifics right now, but... I just know what I see.
Have you ever felt that something strange or unusual was happening that others didn’t seem to notice or agree with?

Well... yes. I mean, I just explained it to you. The things with my sister's appointments, the bills, the phone calls. 

Other people... they just brush it off. They tell me it's administrative errors or people being busy. They don't see it. Or... they pretend not to see it. But I know what's happening. I know they're deliberately keeping me in the dark so I don't have a say in anything. That's... that's the unusual thing.
Do you believe that there is a conspiracy or organized effort against you, or that certain people are working together to harm or deceive you in some way?

I don't know if I'd use the word "conspiracy." That sounds... dramatic. 

But... yes. I mean, I've said it already. It's the same pattern for months. The appointments, the bills, the phone calls. They're all doing it. They say it's mistakes, but... they're working together to keep information from me. To push me out. That's... that's just what it is. I don't really want to keep repeating myself about it.
Do you feel that certain actions or events—like missed calls or changed appointments—are specifically targeted at you or meant to send you a message?

I... I feel like we just went over this. Yes, it's targeted at me. 

Like I've been saying, for months now I've been seeing the exact same pattern. Everyone keeps telling me it's just mistakes, but... I know it isn't. They are deliberately keeping information from me to push me out of the decisions regarding my sister. It's not about sending a secret message or anything, it's just... them trying to cut me out. 

I really don't have much else to add to it.
Outside of the appointments, bills, and missed calls, have you noticed any other events or actions—like things people say or do in public—that you feel are directed at you or meant to exclude you?
No. Not really. Just... what I've already told you. I don't really pay attention to strangers in public. It's just the things with my sister.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something was happening that others didn't seem to notice—like thoughts being taken out of your head, or someone reading your mind?
No. Nothing like that. Just... what we've been talking about.
Have you ever believed something to be true that others have strongly disagreed with, even when there was clear evidence against it?

Yes. That's... exactly what I just told you. 

Everyone disagrees with me about my sister's situation. They all tell me the moved appointments, the wrong bills, the unreturned calls... they say they're all just mistakes. They try to tell me it's just normal clerical errors. But... I know what I see. I know they’re keeping information from me because they want to push me out of the decisions. 

I don't really know how many different ways you want me to say it.
Have you ever believed something so strongly that it seemed completely obvious to you, even if it didn’t make sense to others or wasn’t based on reality?
No. I... I don't know what else you're looking for. I just told you what's happening. It's not... it's not some fantasy. It's just what they're doing.
Have you ever had beliefs that others have told you are not true, and yet you were absolutely certain they were true, even if there was no proof or evidence to support them?

We... we just went over this. You keep asking me the exact same thing. 

I don't have beliefs without proof. The proof is what's been happening for months now. The appointments getting moved around, the billing errors, the people who just conveniently forget to call me back. Everyone else wants to brush it off and tell me they're just mistakes, but... they aren't. They're keeping information from me because they want to push me out of the decisions regarding my sister. 

That's the reality of it. I really don't have anything else to add.
Have you ever had any beliefs that you were certain were true at the time, but later realized were not accurate or were completely false?
No. I haven't. If I believe something is true, it's because it is. I don't... I don't just make things up and then change my mind later. I've told you what's happening, and that's it.
Have you ever believed something that others found completely implausible or that had no basis in reality, such as being contacted by aliens, having special powers, or being part of a secret mission?
No. No aliens or... special powers. I don't know why you would even ask me that. I'm just a normal person trying to deal with a very real problem.
Have you ever felt that things happening around you—like things being said on TV, people talking in public, or random events—were directed at you or had a special meaning for you personally?

No. I don't watch much TV anyway, and... I don't pay attention to strangers talking. I just focus on my own life and the things that actually matter, like my sister's care. I don't know where you're getting all these strange ideas from.
